description: Returns the next Mercury retrograde after a date (or the one in progress, until it stations direct) with its sign, pre-shadow, station retrograde, cazimi, station direct and post-shadow end. Times are UTC, to the minute, from the ephemeris (JPL DE421, 2025–2030). This is astronomical timing, not a horoscope.

from.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD (read as 12:00 UTC). Defaults to now.

name: next_mercury_retrograde
title: Next Mercury retrograde
